blocks.text: The House of Representatives has finally acted on the urgent need to modernize the Philippines’ defenses against espionage. By a vote of 247 in favor, 10 against, and none abstaining, the chamber last week approved House Bill No. 9642, the proposed New Espionage Act, on third and final reading and transmitted it to the Senate.
